recipes.name: Sunday Night Traybake
recipes.description: One-pan roasted vegetables with a crispy, smoky finish.
steps: Heat the oven to 220C.
Toss everything with oil and paprika on a large tray.
Roast for 35 minutes, shaking halfway.

recipes.name: Monday Glow Bowl
recipes.description: A bright grain bowl with a creamy lemon dressing.
steps: Cook the quinoa and let it cool.
Massage the kale with a pinch of salt.
Whisk the dressing with lemon juice and water, then pour over the bowl.

recipes.name: Friday Pasta Night
recipes.description: Salty, garlicky spaghetti that comes together in 15 minutes.
steps: Boil the spaghetti.
Melt the fillets into warm oil with the garlic and chilli.
Toss with the pasta, a splash of pasta water and the parsley.

recipes.name: Mum's Winter Soup
recipes.description: A thick, filling soup for cold evenings.
steps: Soften the chopped vegetables in butter.
Add the grains and stock.
Simmer for 50 minutes until thick.

recipes.name: Desk Lunch Wraps
recipes.description: Grilled cheese and roasted pepper wraps that travel well.
steps: Slice and griddle the cheese until golden.
Layer everything into the wraps.
Roll tightly and wrap in foil.

recipes.name: Weekend Breakfast Bake
recipes.description: A big sharing dish of eggs, potatoes and spiced sausage.
steps: Roast the diced potatoes for 25 minutes.
Add the sliced sausage for 10 minutes.
Crack in the eggs and bake until just set.

recipes.name: Harira
recipes.description: Moroccan tomato and lentil soup, traditionally served to break the fast during Ramadan.
steps: Fry the onion, celery and spices.
Add lentils, tomatoes and water.
Simmer 40 minutes and finish with lemon and coriander.

recipes.name: Shakshuka
recipes.description: Eggs poached in a spiced tomato and pepper sauce, eaten with bread.
steps: Soften the peppers with the cumin.
Add the tomatoes and reduce.
Make wells, crack in the eggs, cover until set.

recipes.name: Jook
recipes.description: Cantonese rice porridge simmered for hours, topped with scallion and ginger. Gentle food for sick days.
steps: Rinse the rice.
Simmer in stock with ginger for 90 minutes, stirring often.
Top with scallions and white pepper.

recipes.name: Tarte Tatin
recipes.description: Upside-down caramelised apple tart baked under puff pastry.
steps: Make a dry caramel in an ovenproof pan.
Pack in the quartered apples.
Cover with pastry, bake 30 minutes, then invert onto a plate.

recipes.name: Gazpacho
recipes.description: Chilled Andalusian tomato soup, blended raw and served cold in summer.
steps: Roughly chop everything.
Blend until smooth with oil and vinegar.
Chill for at least 2 hours.

recipes.name: Bircher Jars
recipes.description: Swiss-style oats soaked overnight in the fridge with apple and yoghurt, ready to grab in the morning.
steps: Stir everything together in a jar.
Leave in the fridge overnight.
Top with fruit and eat cold.

recipes.name: Bubble and Squeak
recipes.description: Leftover roast potatoes and greens fried into a crispy patty the day after a roast dinner.
steps: Mix the potato and shredded greens.
Press into a hot buttered pan.
Fry until a deep crust forms, then flip.

recipes.name: Pad Kra Pao
recipes.description: Thai holy basil stir-fry with minced pork, served over rice with a crispy fried egg.
steps: Pound the garlic and chillies.
Stir-fry with the pork until caramelised.
Wilt in the basil and serve with a fried egg.

recipes.name: Sticky Weeknight Wings
recipes.description: Oven-baked wings in a sweet, spicy glaze.
steps: Bake the wings at 220C for 40 minutes.
Warm the glaze ingredients together.
Toss the wings in the glaze and bake 5 more minutes.

recipes.name: Za'atar Flatbreads
recipes.description: Soft yoghurt flatbreads brushed with herby oil.
steps: Mix flour and yoghurt into a dough.
Roll into 6 rounds and dry-fry.
Brush with the za'atar oil while hot.

recipes.name: Salmon Rice Bowls
recipes.description: Seared salmon over sticky rice with quick pickles.
steps: Cook the rice.
Sear the salmon skin-side down.
Serve over rice and shower with furikake.

recipes.name: Fattoush
recipes.description: Crunchy Levantine bread salad.
steps: Toast the torn pitta until crisp.
Chop the salad vegetables.
Dress with oil, lemon, molasses and a heavy pinch of sumac.

recipes.name: Teriyaki Chicken
recipes.description: Glossy homemade teriyaki with chicken thighs.
steps: Brown the chicken.
Add soy, mirin and sugar.
Reduce until sticky and glossy.

recipes.name: Miso Glazed Aubergine
recipes.description: Roasted aubergine halves with a sweet-salty glaze.
steps: Score and roast the aubergine halves for 25 minutes.
Brush with the glaze.
Grill until bubbling and scatter with seeds.

recipes.name: Tadka Dal
recipes.description: Yellow lentils finished with a sizzling spiced butter.
steps: Simmer the split peas with turmeric until soft.
Heat ghee and fry cumin seeds and asafoetida.
Pour the tadka over the dal.

recipes.name: Sweet Chilli Haddock Pie
recipes.description: A simple pie with haddock and sweet chilli flavours.
steps: Prep the haddock and vegetables.
Season with the sweet chilli sauce, lime, spring onions.
Top with pastry and bake for 35 minutes.
Taste, adjust the seasoning and serve.

recipes.name: Smoky Paneer Salad
recipes.description: A fresh salad with paneer and smoky flavours.
steps: Prep the paneer and vegetables.
Season with the smoked paprika, garlic, tomato puree.
Toss together just before serving.
Taste, adjust the seasoning and serve.
